America's crop insurance industry is thankful for the continued support of farmers, commodity organizations, rural businesses, lenders and lawmakers who are fighting to maintain a strong farm safety net. Crop Insurance remains the smartest, most efficient way to secure America's food, fiber, and fuel supply. For AgriPulse, I'm Jeff Daly.
